filesystem.description: Gives the AI a structured way to read, write, and search files in your project. Without this, the agent relies on shell commands — this is cleaner and more reliable.

github.description: Lets the AI interact with GitHub directly — create and read issues, open pull requests, check CI status, and browse repository contents. Requires a GitHub token (set GITHUB_TOKEN in your environment or user.env).

postgres.description: Connects the AI to a PostgreSQL database so it can run queries, inspect table structures, and help debug data issues. Set DATABASE_URL in user.env (e.g. postgres://user:pass@host:5432/db).

sqlite.description: Lets the AI work with SQLite databases in your project. Useful for mobile apps (React Native, Flutter), desktop apps, and any project that stores data locally in SQLite files.

memory.description: Gives the AI a persistent memory that survives between sessions. It can store project decisions, learned patterns, and context so it doesn't lose track of what was discussed previously.

fetch.description: Enables the AI to make HTTP requests — fetch API documentation, check web endpoints, and download resources from the internet. Useful when the AI needs to look up library docs or test API responses.
